definitions.gloss: spring cabbage (early-spring variety, softer and sweeter)
definitions.explanation: A type of cabbage harvested mainly in spring, with softer, lighter-colored leaves and a sweeter, milder taste than ordinary cabbage. Especially prized for raw use such as in salads.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}キャベツのサラダを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made a spring cabbage salad.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}キャベツは{葉|は}が{柔|やわ}らかくて{甘|あま}い。
examples.english: Spring cabbage has soft, sweet leaves.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}キャベツはサラダや{浅漬|あさづ}けなど、{生|なま}で{食|た}べる{料理|りょうり}に{向|む}いている。
examples.english: Spring cabbage is well-suited to dishes eaten raw, such as salads and light pickles.

notes:
Compound of {春|はる} (spring) + キャベツ (cabbage). Marketed as a seasonal product in Japan from around March to May. Has a looser, rounder head than winter cabbage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {春|はる}キャベツの{千切|せんぎ}り: shredded spring cabbage
- {春|はる}キャベツのサラダ: spring cabbage salad
- {春|はる}キャベツを{生|なま}で{食|た}べる: to eat spring cabbage raw

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {冬|ふゆ}キャベツ: winter cabbage — firmer, denser leaves, suited to long cooking (ロールキャベツ)
- {夏|なつ}キャベツ / {高原|こうげん}キャベツ: summer/highland cabbage — grown in cool highland areas
